what: When you hover a news or photo card, the photo frame is cropped inward by .5em on all four edges so it looks like a smaller frame, while the photo inside moves slightly closer at 1.02x (1s cubic-bezier(.19,1,.22,1)). On release it returns along the same path. Card size and position stay put, so the grid doesn’t shake
